children: We were tasked with exploring how a bunch of characters fare on an adventure, facing insurmountable odds, in a great world-building exercise.

Although the full project has been shelved. We're extremely thankful to our creative partners for allowing us to share this incredible project. We're known for our action animation, but we really wanted to push the boat out for "Hypervoltaic Chronicles." High-intensity camera work, dynamic lineless characters, and stylized backgrounds result in something truly amazing. And something we're very proud of.

children: Into the den of the beasts

‘’How do you present a dense and massive world without missing a beat of the action?’’. That was the question I asked myself when starting Hypervoltaic Chronicles. I wanted an epic sequence that told a bigger story, that hinted at a world with a complex past and a hint of what its future might be. For the characters to be your guide, but for the environments surrounding them to tell the story. To also create something that was as vibrant as it was extraordinary.
